mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_file ( board_id, original_name, saved_name, file_path, file_size ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{originalName}, #{savedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize} )
mapper.select: SELECT id AS fileId, original_name AS originalName, file_size AS fileSize, CONCAT('/api/boards/', board_id, '/files/', id, '/download') AS downloadUrl FROM board_file WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND deleted = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id AS fileId, board_id AS boardId, original_name AS originalName, saved_name AS savedName, file_path AS filePath, file_size AS fileSize, created_at AS createdAt FROM board_file WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND id = #{fileId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE board_file SET deleted = 0 WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND deleted = 1
